description: The latest snapshot of a company: as-of period, release date and time of publication, coverage, conventions (units, signs, fiscal calendar), validation summary, available statements, files with SHA-256 and the citation format. With at, the snapshot that was the latest on that date (point in time).

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple or mizuho

name: get_snapshot_info
title: Get snapshot information
